additional_info.subject: Additional information
additional_info.body: We are once again looking for loads and transfers. In March, we noticed two strange ones. Both loads were at the charger with the SR: 170003981. Could you please send us the corresponding loading protocols for March 15, 2025, time: 14:00 to 15:00, and for March 26, 2025, time: 04:00 to 05:00? We have deductions here for which we cannot find a suitable load and would like to reconcile what happened at the charger at that time. In the backend, I can only see successful loads and no canceled ones. The screen has delaminated, we request repair. See picture.

additional_info.subject: Additional notes
additional_info.body: At that time, I was unable to add this to TS SID queue., there was some technical issue.
